description: Frozen check IDs and the closed anchor rule for evidence submission. Check IDs are assigned once here and are never re-derived from prose order; a clause change in evidence-verification.md requires an explicit edit here under a new revision.
submission_rule: Clients submit exactly one anchor artifact per required role (anchor per role kind below) in artifact_ids, at most 32; a submitted ID that is not the anchor of any role is unconsumed and returns 400 VALIDATION_FAILED reason SEMANTIC_INVALID.

anchor_rules.role_kind: job group (request/run/metrics/result, request/job-event/checkpoint, attempt/token/request, validation/import result)
anchor_rules.anchor: the job's immutable request artifact (Job.request.artifact_id); the verifier reaches the run, metrics, result, events, checkpoint and attempt through registry relations

anchor_rules.role_kind: metrics, evaluation records, paired evaluation, generation, bundle, preflight/diagnostic/E01/reuse receipt

and no interpreter path or probe filename is present. The verifier does not regrade P00-SHIFT, P00-JSONL, or P00-MEAN as execution evidence. Passing is optional prerequisite evidence and MUST NOT increment required-module completion

The preserved lesson/lab bytes remain unchanged, and their external files are never imported or relabelled as companion execution. The data permission judgment, leakage-limit explanation, comparison interpretation, complete-path explanation, and bounded final claim remain assessor reviewed
